messages:
anya (ML): FYI — ACME just filed a request for a customer-specific model variant. Requirements: instruct-style behavior, long context (64k), int4 quant target, KMS keys + private deployment. They also want regressions <=3% on our FAQ eval.

sam (eng-ml): do we have their prompt set? 64k will change latency profile a lot.

customer-success (CS): they uploaded ~500 sample threads to s3: s3://acme-onboarding/64k_samples.csv. They want canary rollout and ability to opt-out.

anya (ML): thanks — plan proposal in-thread: 1) create long-context base build (no tuning) using chunked KV and our longctx kernels; 2) run baseline eval (quality + latency) on their 500 prompts; 3) try quantization path: per-layer int8 -> int4 with QLoRA fallback if needed; 4) instruction-tune small seed set if delta > threshold; 5) canary rollout + monitor. Prioritization: MED (they're Dedicated customer but not enterprise contract yet).

sam (eng-ml): instrumentation checklist: record p50/p95 latency, tokens/request, peak GPU mem, KV cache hit-rate, cost estimate, and quality metrics (ROUGE, EM, hallucination rate). Also add regression alert at >3% on ROUGE and >2% increase in hallucination.

devin (infra): resource note — running full 64k KV natively needs >=80GB GPU to avoid offload. Options: 1) use 2x48GB with sharded KV, 2) enable KV offload to host with async streaming. Offload will impact p95.

sam (eng-ml): can we get a quick config for canary?

devin (infra): sure — example rollout config: ```json
{ "model_variant": "acme-instruct-64k-int4", "canary": [ {"percent": 5, "duration": "24h"}, {"percent": 25, "duration": "48h"}, {"percent": 100, "duration": "72h"} ], "fallback": "hosted-generic-instruct-v1", "sla_blockers": ["p95_latency > 2s over baseline", "ROUGE drop > 3%" ] }
```

maria (product): timeline ask — realistic ETA to get a safe prototype?

anya (ML): prototype (internal) 10 business days to produce base longctx build + initial int8 tests. Int4 experiments add ~4 business days (more tuning + eval). If we need instruction tuning for customer, add 1–2 weeks.

eval-bot: Eval queued — job q-78321 created for acme/64k_baseline. Metrics to compute: ROUGE-L, EM, PPL, hallucination-score.

sam (eng-ml): quick note on eval harness: need to extend sampling for long prompts — current harness truncates at 8k. I'll open an issue to bump max length and add streaming token capture.

customer-success (CS): one more constraint — ACME requires HIPAA / private deployment w/ KMS. Add to intake.

anya (ML): added. Owners: anya (lead ML), sam (eval + tuning), devin (infra/canary). Next steps: 1) sam to extend harness + run baseline on provided set (ETA 3 days); 2) devin to provision staging infra and deploy base longctx build (ETA 5 days); 3) anya to draft quant schedule and eval thresholds (ETA 2 days). We'll sync EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

maria (product): sounds good. schedule a 30m sync after the harness run. I'll invite ACME to watch the canary once we hit 5%. :calendar:
